failures.subject: INTERAC e-Transfer received
failures.body:
Hello,

You received an INTERAC e-Transfer.

The money has been automatically deposited into the account ending in 4021. To see the amount and the sender, sign in to RBC Online Banking.

This is an automated message. Please do not reply to this email.

Thank you for banking with RBC Royal Bank.

failures.subject: Your CIBC eDeposit is ready
failures.body:
A cheque image was deposited to your CIBC account.

Sign in to CIBC Online Banking to view the amount and the deposit details.

This is an automated notification about activity on your account.

failures.subject: A new Interac e-Transfer notification
failures.body:
You have a new Interac e-Transfer notification.

Someone sent you money. Log in to your Tangerine account to accept or decline this transfer before it expires.

Reference: TXN-7741-22

failures.subject: Transaction alert
failures.body:
Simplii Financial transaction alert

A transaction was made on your Simplii Financial No Fee Chequing Account. The amount was not included in this notification.

The final details will appear on your account statement.

failures.subject: Your eStatement is ready to view
failures.body:
Your latest account statement is now available in RBC Online Banking.

Sign in to view or download it. This is a service message about your account, not a transaction.
